1928, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 33 Cont.
Aug. 9 May 8 or 9 Barbara Haag Enrolled one year - continual convulsions - only 5 months old. Parents promise perpetual Enrollment if child improves. To-night they bring her stiff and rigid, crying and in spasms, asking to have a Mass said in Honor of St. Anthony. Fr. S. asked, "Did you see no improvement?" "Yes, Some .. " ....... "Then a single Mass," said Fr. S. "will not help. Keep your promise and God will do the rest." They pay $3. on perpetual enrolment. At once she sleeps & smiles. !!! $600.00 on doctors
Page 34
Aug. 15 Andrew Benga 20 - Consumptive
Geo Brouckaert 8 - pneumonia in Children Hospitol - operation at 2 o'cl. To-day (22nd) His Mother Agnes paralysed in whole left arm at decision of Specialist to operate
Tim ... from Chicago 18 - paralysed
Old Mrs. Wall
Sister Stepen - Vocation Saved
Aug. 20
Monday - Dorothy Neary 24 - 5712 Winslow Ave. £ Enrolled as against stomach trouble -"Ulcers" Could not eat - milk & cream only. Enrol- led July 27 then intending to have ex-ray Examination next day ..... Went on excursion to Buffalo in perfect health. Enrolles To-night perpetually - herself and Poor Souls. Deo Gratias! P.S. She promised perpetual enrollment ....
Page 35 Aug. 29th Joseph F. Ryan - Unionport Pa. !!! Robert LeBeaux - Lake Lindon !! Rose LeTere - blindness O.Kd! Boy not operated on last Wed.
Alex. Smith (40) 4472 Field - Convert - Sleeping Sickness eight years; Enrolled five weeks ago 50c - Wife promising perpetual Enrollment if positive improvement came - To-day Aug. 23 Enrolls him $5.00 Deo Gr.
